name: Apex's Modpack
_settings_help: type: one_in (shown '1 in N'), percent (N%), int (N + unit), number (decimals), bool (On/Off). {key} in a desc shows that setting's current value.

modules.title: Nel's Auto Battler Sex Autonomy Mod
modules.desc: At the start of each of her turns, Nel has a {chance} chance to taunt the monsters, teasing them to come and fuck her until she orgasms.

subs.title: Half XP
subs.desc: Balancing: Celica only gets {xp_share} of the battle XP while Nel is in control.

subs.title: Never One-Shots
subs.desc: Balancing: Nel's first hit on a monster leaves it on 1 HP; the next hit kills it.

settings.label: Taunt chance
settings.help: Checked at the start of each of Nel's turns.

settings.label: Cooldown after a taunt
settings.help: Nel's turns without a new taunt after one ends.

settings.label: How often Nel talks while taunting
settings.help: Her teasing lines, waiting lines and reactions.

settings.label: Taunt time limit
settings.help: A taunt ends by itself after this many monster actions on her.

settings.label: Lust bar needed: 1st climax of the day
settings.help: How full her lust bar must be to climax. Resets when Celica sleeps.

settings.label: Lust bar needed: 5th climax and later
Celica's XP share (Half XP)
settings.help: Only used while the Half XP sub-mod is on.

settings.label: Nel's body influence per climax
settings.help: While she possesses Celica. The unmodded game gives 10.

modules.title: Game Engine Stutter Fix
modules.desc: Removes the short battle freezes when a pose changes (caches the game's file searches).

modules.title: Appearance Menu Insta Unlock
modules.desc: The Equip > Appearance tab is open from the start, on new games and old saves.

modules.title: Celica's Autonomy Dildo Events
modules.desc: On quiet mornings there is a {chance} chance that Celica uses the dildo by herself as soon as she wakes, before she gets up (Nel joins in if she's there).

settings.label: Lewdness needed
settings.help: The game's own rule for using the dildo is 30.

modules.title: Clothing Remover
modules.desc: Red-X Shoes / Top / Pants items fully remove that clothing, including its protective combat states, so she stays exposed.

settings.label: Red-X items: stat strength
settings.help: 100% = Allure and Lewdness +25; Willpower, Cooldown, Arcane and Speed -25.

modules.title: H-Scene Idle Loop
modules.desc: Grope and H-scene animations and their sounds keep looping on your turn instead of showing a still image. Purely visual: it doesn't affect gameplay.

settings.label: Idle loop sounds
settings.help: Replay the animation's sounds while the loop plays.

settings.label: Idle loop sound volume
settings.help: Compared with the normal sound volume.

settings.label: Switch between animations
settings.help: With several monsters on her, switch animations every few seconds.

modules.title: HD x8 Upscale Project
modules.desc: AI-upscaled HD pictures (x8), added a block at a time: characters and backgrounds so far (see the HD Project page). Used when the window is bigger than 1066x600. Needs the HD pack. Switch HD on or off in game with F8 or the HD Toggle button.

settings.label: Picture memory
settings.help: How many pictures stay loaded. Lower it if the game runs out of memory.

modules.title: Inventory Scroll Mod
modules.desc: Every item grid scrolls with the mouse wheel and grows a row when it is nearly full: ITEMS and SPELLS, and Appearance and Accessories in Equip.

modules.title: Combat Helpers
modules.desc: Green / Orange / Red accessories with 10% / 50% / 100% of Speedster's Blessing stats, for when the fights get too hard.

settings.label: Combat Helper Green strength
settings.help: Percent of the Speedster's Blessing stats.

settings.label: Combat Helper Orange strength
settings.help: Percent of the Speedster's Blessing stats.

settings.label: Combat Helper Red strength
settings.help: Percent of the Speedster's Blessing stats.

modules.title: Movable Inventory Items
modules.desc: Hold the left mouse button on an item, drag it onto another square and let go to swap them. Works in every grid of the Inventory Scroll Mod (needs it on).

modules.title: Inventory Backups
modules.desc: Keeps a backup of your items and gold each time you arrive somewhere new (the last {backups}); the ↺ button under the inventory puts one back.

settings.label: Inventory backups kept
settings.help: One backup each time you arrive somewhere new. 0 = no backups.
